{{Top|leg}}
A '''Sonic capsule''' was a small handheld device. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] gave [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] a sonic capsule as a birthday gift.<ref name="TGH">{{DroidsCite|The Great Heep}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==

The sonic capsule appeared in the one-hour animated television film, that serves as a prequel to the [[Mungo Baobab]] cycle of episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]''.
